messages:
maya: quick sync 10: partner proxy causing billing to attribute to proxy org instead of partner project. console vs billing mismatch. any ideas?
owen: seen it before. token exchange strips origin claims so downstream only sees proxy.
lee: could proxy add an `x-origin` header for observability?
kevin: headers are forgeable. for billing we need authenticity: signed-origin claim or server-side exchange-id mapping.
own: mapping seems easiest for partners. exchange records exchange_id->origin at mint and routing does a cache lookup.
sam: quota enforcement needs request-time project. mapping must be low-latency cache or enforcement stays on proxy identity while we run a "would-have" quota.
maya: proposed rollout: phase1 telemetry-only (1% sample, 14d); phase2 dashboard + inferred-origin column; phase3 canary exchange-id mapping for partner P-42 in us-west-2 (10% sampling, 72h); phase4 optional signed-origin pilot.
kevin: I'll add counters: auth.exchange.lookup_requested, auth.exchange.lookup_hit, auth.exchange.lookup_miss, auth.exchange.lookup_latency_ms, auth.reconcile.delta_pct and create a dash stub.
own: prototyping LRU memcache + redis fallback TTL=5m; will report p50/p99.
lee: console UX: toggle "Show inferred origin (exchange-id)" and a help flyout explaining why billed org may differ.
sam: canary playbook: partner=P-42, region=us-west-2, sampling=10%, alert if reconciliation delta >3% or cache miss >2% for 15m.
auth-bot: deploy triggered svc-auth-exchange v3.2.0 -> canary us-west-2 (1/4).
maya: action items: kevin telemetry/dash, owen cache prototype+flag, sam playbook, lee console mock, maya rollout doc. thanks!
